nom: medicube Kojic Acid Turmeric Gel Mask

avis.texte: I'm so confused on the rating for this product but I guess its different for everyone. This is THEE best face mask I've ever used. Leaving it on overnight my skin was soo plump and it brightened my dark spots. I love Medicube because I see real results with all of their products when used consistently.
Its a good enough sheet mask. Hydrating and feels nice. Downside is the shape. I can cut the eyes to fix that shape but the mouth is so weird. The upper lip is huge and cant really cut to fix it.
These make my skin so glowy and hydrated. I have probalems with dry skin and peeing particularly on my nose. When I use this mask, the next day I have beautiful, glowing skin, and no dryness!

avis.titre: returning these ASAP - save yourself and avoid
avis.texte: I have chemical burns, dryness and major deep, painful acne from using Medicube masks - none of which I had prior to use. Wish I has researched the brand more before purchasing, look at reviews on other sites before purchasing and save your skin!

I love these masks with someone who has hyperpigmentation these have helped DRASTICALLY I will use them forever ! Also I do have combo skin sometimes sensitive but have no issues , if concern about sensitivity is the layering method put a moisturizer down first !
This is the first mask I've ever used with immediate results! I am very impressed and love them. I was glowing all day after wearing overnight.

Buy this mask if you enjoy being uncomfortable in your own skin and itchy. The entire medicube line is a social media cash grab. These masks smell very nice but that is so unnecessary. I immediately felt my skin become itchy and irritated after applying it. I barely kept this on for 5 minutes. I'm writing this review the next day. My face is incredibly itchy and its dry everywhere. Lots of tiny bumps and texture.
I do this mask and the pink mask at least once a week and my face feels like heaven after.

I have used many k-beauty gel masks and was excited to try this as I am trying to fade sun spots. While wearing the mask, it felt fine. The next day my skin was tingly and the following day, the skin around my mouth is burned. Feels like a chemical peel or sunburn. Proceed with caution!
I love this gel mask! It smells great and leaves my skin glowing and hydrated after. I dont have any skin issues and just use it for upkeep
